column1: # done_enemies (batch 4, _todo rows 301-350) — srcline <TAB> english. Realm badges skipped.

column2: Remember the fear of being dominated by that glass-cannon Scorpion Dragon deep in the realm? From here on, mob health ratios double!
Heh, here comes the glass-cannon~
To this day we still don't know why the Shifeng Family teams up Sky-Tier Rank 4 with Earth-Tier Rank 1. The nouveau-riche family's lack of depth is on full display.
If there were one of these on Misty Island, Babata would probably never find an heir.
Bzzt bzzt bzzt—— a Shiny Pikachu (crossed out) descends!
Envy has disfigured the Furball beyond recognition. Why do YOU get a sword hilt made from a spaceship reactor?! Waaaah!
A skeleton born of the ice element; its life force is remarkably tenacious!
Didn't expect a sequel~ Neko has tapped less than 1% of the Furball's potential.
Didn't you know? Scattered Bloom only weakens the enemy if your own health is high enough.
Ice-Shard Sword, on the other hand, can whittle the enemy down regardless of health. Truly a powerful insight…
For a Deathsworn to not even carry a Self-Destruct — all its skills just boost damage… and Sky Sword was too hard, so it never learned it!
Looks exactly like the Barrier Lake tank, yet it's actually a glass-cannon!
The missing cyan Budding Furball is finally found! Though it turned itself this color with outside help.
This is the Rainbow Attack! Furball family, move out~
Looks strong, and it really isn't weak either. Taking a 40-hit combo from it is quite a handful.
6-hit combo… at least easier to handle than that bunch that opens with huge burst damage, right?
Shoveling a bit down below to make a snowball — seems like it might turn a little profit?
Why is this place full of these pre-battle health-draining insights?! So scary, so scary, so scary……
How nice it'd be if the Laser could melt the ice and snow here……
Rare to get one with a more normal attribute. Fortify is so much friendlier than that bunch that comes screaming in and freezes you at the start… yes, this is a bonus stage!
Phew~ I'm going to stand in front of it and heal. Nobody stop me.
Yes, every zone has its own Ice-Shard Sword~ this is our Pure White Ice Field.
Time-Seal? Its health is too thin… can it really survive to a second attack?
Rainbow Attack: (2/7)!! Budding alone and holding a weapon alone are both useless, but combined… looks like a destined spirit-treasure!
No different from the last one except much thinner health. The six that ganged up on you earlier were already the elites…
Sadly, because it's so cold with ice element everywhere, there's no lake to fish here… the live fish all crawled out!
It's this one… not only is its aura strong, it stacks too! Really too much!
Rainbow Attack (3/7)! How can a special ability compare to a well-tempered… Furball body?
Not only is its own temperature near 0K, it also holds a lethal dose of ice element. One of these can neutralize dozens of 【Nuclear-Blast Energy】!
Long, long ago, the 【Yangang City】 area had a monster that looked about the same… I remember the first commit, forgot the middle — anyway, se-no! Internet saikou! (The internet is the best!)
Rainbow Attack (4/7)! It's only a tiny bit stronger than the last one, isn't it…
A blood-boiling combo skill, a 1.08e11 (crossed out) 4.8e10 execution threshold! Though due to RPG mechanics, the Ice-Seal-and-Holy-Array combo has vanished.
It's actually part of a series too. Your laser-using brother is a bit far from here…
Come to think of it, is the Deepfrost Ice Palace's hostility a bit too much? So many fellows with the 【Hostile】 prefix!
A dragon subspecies with an extremely low body temperature that can unleash a frost breath.
Dual-blade style! Left sword, high damage~ right sword, high damage!
After the long road comes something rivaling Chaos 10th-Rebirth… oops, wrong crossover — this Cathedral is clearly much smaller than the scrambled-egg one…
An Earth-realm cultivator turns to stone from a single glare. But against mid-Sky-Tier-and-above combatants, such a trick has only a feeble effect.
Stack armor, pass! This sorcerer is super strong yet overly cautious — not that it helps.
Compared to the dual-blade fighter, this one hews closer to the so-called defense-kill strategy. 2.8e8 defense lets it tower over the rest… except those Ice-Seal and Frostbite gimmick monsters!
Everybody's got it~ banzai! This time it's packing super-strong Absolute-Zero · Flash-Freeze ammo!
【Ad space for rent】: urgently need a Restraint-roasting joke here~
If you tossed the whole vanguard into a low-lightspeed, black-hole-like place like this, this sect is probably not far from death…
Does it really not melt…? Maybe it has a Deepfrost-engine cycle built into its body?
Luckily this is a transcendent world; even without oxygen, its roots won't rot!
